jobs.description:
**Company Description** **Work with Us. Change the World.**


At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.


There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.


We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.

 **Job Description** **AECOM** is seeking an **Environmental Scientist II** to join our Environmental Health and Safety (EHS) team.**We are seeking candidates to fill a seconded role as an on\-site Health \& Safety Specialist for a program in Rancho Cordova, California**. This full\-time position within our Environmental group will provide and coordinate support related to Health \& Safety and Environmental Compliance in a research and development laboratory and office setting. The duration of this position will be contingent upon AECOM maintaining our contract with the client.

**Job Summary/Responsibilities:**

* Manage and support health, safety and environmental projects and programs, including planning, coordination, execution, and tracking of deliverables to ensure compliance and timely completion.
* Conduct on‑site inspections to evaluate compliance with federal, state, and local environmental regulations (e.g., air, water, waste, hazardous materials).
* Review permits, plans, records, and monitoring data to verify adherence to regulatory requirements and permit conditions.
* Identify violations, non‑conformances, and environmental risks; document findings through clear, detailed inspection reports.
* Investigate citizen complaints, spill reports, or alleged violations and determine appropriate enforcement or corrective actions.
* Communicate findings and compliance requirements to facility representatives; provide technical guidance on corrective measures and best practices.
* Coordinate with regulatory agencies and internal stakeholders to support enforcement actions, follow‑up inspections, or compliance reviews.
* Maintain inspection records, databases, and tracking systems to ensure accurate documentation and timely reporting.
* Interpret and apply relevant regulations (e.g., Clean Air Act, Clean Water Act, RCRA, EPCRA) to inspection activities and compliance determinations.
* Participate in compliance assistance outreach, training sessions, or stakeholder meetings to promote environmental stewardship and regulatory awareness.
* Interprets and records data, conducts analyses, compares findings to relevant studies and local, state and federal regulations to ensure compliance. Work is performed with minimal direction.
* Performing complex assignments often requires the development of unique solutions to problems.
* Participating in internal and client required calls.

**About AECOM’s Environment Business Line**  

Join AECOM to be part of an expert global team who is connected through a well\-developed, worldwide, internal technical practice network through which you can learn from and brainstorm with the best in the world. AECOM is an industry\-leading, world class environmental firm, and we want you to succeed within it. We respect and encourage your own pathway to excellence via our Freedom to Grow initiative.  

  

AECOM is known for our award\-winning technical excellence, leading\-edge science and innovative project delivery. We provide sustainable solutions for some of the world’s most challenging issues. Our global clients and their projects span a variety of market sectors and geographies and require innovative technical solutions to solve wide\-ranging environmental problems.

 **Qualifications** **Minimum Requirements:**

* BA/BS in related sciences.
* 2 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education in supporting environmental projects related to health and safety and environmental compliance.
* Valid U.S. Driver's license is required for this role.
* Due to the nature of work, US citizenship is required.
* Candidate must be able to meet medical clearance requirements of an OSHA (HAZWOPER) medical surveillance physical exam.

**Preferred Qualification**

* 4\+ years of relevant experience working on environmental projects related to health and safety and environmental compliance in California.
* Previous experience with research and development laboratories.
* Previous experience working as an environmental consultant.
* OSHA 40\-hour HAZWOPER Training with annual 8\-hour refresher.

  

**Additional Information**  

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. ***To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in\-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.***

-----------


This position is a Physical Scientist (Hazmat), GS\- 1301\-12 working in Sacramento, California for the Divison of Environmental Affairs.

Learn more about this agency

-----------------------

U.S. Citizens, Nationals or those who owe allegiance to the U.S.
### **Career transition (CTAP, ICTAP, RPL)**

----------

**Position Title:** Program Coordinator\-Pathways to Wellness **FLSA Status:** Non\-Exempt

**Department/Program:** Pathways to Wellness **Location:** Onsite – Pacoima

**Wage Range:** $28\-$30 **Job Status:** Regular FT

**Reports To:** Program Manager\-Community Wellness **Travel Required:**  15%

MEND\-Meet Each Need with Dignity is a nonprofit organization headquartered in Pacoima, CA serving the crisis needs of the most vulnerable community members since 1971\. Operating the San Fernando Valley’s most extensive Community Nourishment Programs, MEND distributes almost 4 million pounds of good food a year. In alignment with MEND’s mission and long\-term commitment to strengthen families and the community, MEND helps individuals address and overcome the long\-term challenges that have kept them from thriving through more intensive services. Our team embraces and lives our organizational values, contributing to a compelling and inspiring work environment. MEND is recognized as a highly impactful nonprofit by Charity Navigator, Candid, and Great Nonprofits, and has received recognition as best nonprofit and favorite workplace in Daily News Reader’s Choice Awards since 2022\.

**POSITION SUMMARY**:

Under the direction of the Program Manager – Community Wellness, the Program Coordinator is responsible for overseeing the day\-to\-day operation, service delivery and achievement of strategic goals and objectives for our Pathways to Wellness Program, which offer group activities (such as nutrition classes, exercise groups, shopping simulations) and 1:1 coaching, including the development and monitoring of individual success plans that support participants achievement of their specific wellness goals. The Program Coordinator provides individualized support to participants who are experiencing or at risk for chronic, diet\-related health conditions (such as diabetes, hypertension, obesity, etc.). Services include 1:1 coaching, resource navigation, and development of individual success plans. The Program Coordinator will utilize best practices for coaching support, goal planning, and linking to resources. The Program Coordinator will monitor participant’s progress on individual goals and objectives. This program provide medical advice or diagnosis – the objective is to be an accountability partner in achieving lifestyle changes that support the management of their conditions. The Program Coordinator will supervise the Pathways Health Education Specialist.

The ideal candidate is highly organized and community\-driven provisional who is passionate about advancing health equity and supporting underserved populations. This individual is a strong relationship\-builder who demonstrates leadership through initiative, accountability and advocacy.

* Oversight of all MEND Pathways to Wellness services, ensuring high\-quality services and achievement of agency and funder goals for program completion, health and wellness goals are met.
* Supervise Pathways Specialist in the oversight of their assigned caseload and in the implementation of program activities.
* Provides ongoing case management to an assigned caseload of participants enrolled in the Pathways to Wellness Program, providing formal and informal coaching and guidance and co\-create Individual Success Plan (ISP) with participants to reach their individual wellness goals. Tracks and reports on required data points as scheduled.
* Maintains and regularly updates Individual Success Plan (ISP) in collaboration with enrolled participants, monitoring progress and targeted biometric improvements.
* Develops a trusting and open relationship with enrolled participants and assists with decision\-making and referrals in relation to wellness and addressing key social determinants of health. Assist participants with accessing resources and services to increase stability (e.g. linkage to primary care physicians, health insurance, food banks, housing).
* Collaborates with Pathways to Wellness team to ensure high\-quality services and achievement of agency and funder goals for program completion, health and wellness goals are met. Monitors program spending and ensures expenses are in budget and are allowable.
* Collaborates with the Pathway to Wellness and Community Nourishment Teams to develop training materials, lesson plans, prepare materials and procure food to support program activities. Present workshops on topics that empower participants to increase their nutrition and health literacy and self\-advocacy. Leverages readily available public resources through LA City \& County and U.S. Department of Public Health.
* Maintains accurate, well\-written/well\-documented case notes, and progress reports; conducts quarterly case file reviews to ensure conformance to program expectations and participant records are complete.
* Builds robust collaborations with other providers and community\- and faith\-based organizations that can support our participants wellness goals and address key Social Determinants of Health; stays aware of community resources to help meet participant needs; conduct community outreach to recruit eligible participants.
* Participates in department meetings, case conferences to support participant goals and program outcomes.

**About Atlas**

Atlas is a trusted leader in environmental and infrastructure consulting services; we provide services that enable communities to flourish and thrive. With a team of 3,500 employees and offices throughout the US, we combine local expertise and a network of relationships to deliver solutions to both public and private clients. Our services help improve the quality of life in the communities where we live and work. We always aim for smart, safe, and sustainable results. At Atlas we understand that our future is everyone’s responsibility, and we create a better experience at every stage of a project.


**Job Description**

Join Our Team as a **Certified Erosion and Sediment Control Lead (CESCL)** to support fish passage restoration projects. We’re looking for a skilled CESCL to monitor stormwater and manage environmental compliance for fish passage restoration projects near Bellingham, WA. You will collaborate with construction teams to facilitate these a project to repair culvert barriers for migrating fish beneath state highways. This is a fantastic opportunity to accelerate your professional growth, with the potential to transition into various roles within the company as individual FHEP projects conclude.


**Core Responsibilities**

* Conduct tree inventories.
* Conduct vegetation surveys.
* Read and interpret construction drawings and specifications.
* Assist in wetland delineation, fish exclusion and identification.
* Contribute to the development of plans and reports.

**You’ll thrive here if you have**


* Bachelor’s degree in Environmental Science, Biology, Ecology, Botany, Geology, Engineering, or a related field.
* 0\-5 years of professional experience, making this a great opportunity for motivated entry\-level candidates.
* Background in stormwater management, geology, engineering, biology, or a related discipline, providing a strong foundation for a wide range of environmental responsibilities.
* Willingness to work outdoors in various weather conditions, including rain or shine, and on uneven terrain, reflecting a hands\-on approach to fieldwork.
* A strong enthusiasm for fieldwork, with the majority of the role focused on conducting environmental assessments and monitoring in the field.
* Availability for occasional night and weekend shifts, particularly during August and September
* Successful candidates will thrive as key members of a multidisciplinary team focused on environmental documentation, permitting, and construction monitoring for major transportation and fish barrier projects in the Bellingham area.
* Develop detailed technical reports and plans that are crucial for permitting processes and ensuring construction compliance, directly contributing to the success of high\-impact projects.
* Demonstrate expertise in creating clear and effective figures, charts, and tables using tools such as MS Excel, Bluebeam, GIS, and other relevant platforms to communicate technical information with precision.
* Preferred (but not required): Experience in wetland delineation, tree and stream assessments, and construction monitoring.
* While not mandatory, experience in mentoring team members and managing budgets is a valuable asset, showcasing leadership and resource management skills.
* Proficient in using a variety of field equipment to collect precise and reliable data, demonstrating hands\-on expertise.
* While not required, experience in environmental science, particularly in contaminated soil and groundwater, is a plus and adds valuable perspective to the role.
* Ability to work independently while also excelling in a collaborative team environment.
* Positive, adaptable, and team\-oriented approach to work.
* Valid driver’s license required, as this position may involve travel to multiple project sites, ensuring flexibility and accessibility.

new_jobs.description:
**Job Description**
===================

**Purpose:**


The GIS Analyst II is responsible for managing, maintaining, and optimizing geospatial data and workflows across multiple engineering and operational projects. This role utilizes both desktop and web\-based GIS applications to visualize, analyze, and share geospatial information internally and externally.




The GIS Analyst II works collaboratively with the GIS team, engineering, and project management groups, providing technical guidance, workflow improvements, and automation solutions to enhance efficiency and data integrity. This position requires advanced technical expertise in GIS data management, schema development, and spatial analysis, along with a strong ability to communicate and train others.

**Responsibilities**
====================

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Edit, update, and manage GIS data in related platforms.
* Develop and maintain databases and data models to ensure consistency and standardization.
* Perform data conversions, exports, and translations
* Generate map products, dashboards, and web applications to support engineering and project teams.
* Provide technical support and training for GIS Portal users and internal stakeholders.
* Conduct QA/QC reviews to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and integrity across projects.
* Utilize Geoprocessing tools and spatial analysis to solve complex spatial problems and support decision\-making.
* Develop and document workflows, procedures, and system specifications for project implementation and process improvement.
* Interact with clients, subcontractors, and project teams to ensure reliable and efficient data integration and transfer.
* Identify and implement new GIS workflows to increase efficiency, accuracy, and team collaboration.
* Mentor and train GIS Technicians and Analysts on data standards, tools, and system usage.




**Key Measures / Key Performance Indicators:**

* Accuracy, completeness, and timeliness of GIS deliverables
* Effectiveness of automation and workflow improvements
* Quality and integrity of SDE database structures
* Internal stakeholder and client satisfaction with GIS support
* Adherence to data and documentation standards

**Requirements**
================

**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in **Geographic Information Systems (GIS), Geospatial Sciences, or related technical field**, or equivalent experience.




**Experience:**

* Minimum 6\+ years of professional GIS experience, preferably in engineering, utilities, or telecommunications.
* Advanced proficiency in Field Maps environments.
* Strong knowledge of spatial analysis, schema design, and database management.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to see high\-level project goals while managing detailed technical execution.
* Telecom industry experience or familiarity with telecommunications data preferred.

**Exposure**


* Frequent collaboration with Engineering, Project Management, and Field Operations teams.
* Interaction with clients, subcontractors, and external data providers.
* Exposure to telecommunications infrastructure data, GIS system architecture, and process automation initiatives.




* **Factors critical to success at ITG Communications for this position:**
* High technical proficiency and strong attention to detail in geospatial data management.
* Collaborative mindset and communication skills to support cross\-functional teams.
* Continuous improvement orientation, identifying automation and workflow efficiencies to advance GIS performance.




**Physical Requirements**:


* Primarily office\-based with extended use of a computer.
* Must be able to sit for long periods and occasionally lift up to 25 lbs.
* Occasional travel for training or team coordination may be required.
